body.name: Positive-real frontier compiler handle \(\mathfrak C_p(G,G')\)
body.construction: Build the target compiler from terminal-copy min-cut certificates, the sparse factor-line systems \(\mathfrak B_p(G,G')\), common-topological elimination, running \(p(p+1)/2\)-moment accumulators, recursive faces of the baseline covariance cone, Schur-complement sign cells, and branch-gluing certificates. For bounded \(\omega_p(G,G')\), use local subresultant and Thom-sign tables on the elimination bags. In each chamber, the output is either a relatively dense positive-real realization cover or a full-dimensional linkage, affine, covariance-cone-face, or positivity separator in the bit model \(\operatorname{Enc}(p,G,G')\).
